question: Who are enrolled in 3 degree programs in one semester? List the first name, middle name and last name and the id.
gold_query: SELECT T1.first_name , T1.middle_name , T1.last_name , T1.student_id FROM Students AS T1 JOIN Student_Enrolment AS T2 ON T1.student_id = T2.student_id GROUP BY T1.student_id HAVING count(*) = 3
